items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What's your name, Clashy? Clastonet Ward... And you're Punch's niece, huh? Yes, I am.

ctx.x: What's your name, Clashy? Clastonet Ward. Over there. Over there. Little Island. Clastonet Ward. And you're Punch's niece, huh? Yes, I am. Well, we're going back to it now. Let Punch do a little talk. Yeah. Okay. Uh, let's see, you live here with your niece.
